Our latest holiday cheat sheet is jam-packed with our favorite tech, along with Play-Doh, vinyl, and plenty of analog picks.
If you buy something from a link, The Verge may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.
Gift-giving isn’t just about grabbing something solid under a determined spending limit. It’s an expression of love, a way to show someone how well you really know them. That doesn’t mean you have to do it all on your own, though. Sometimes you just need a push in the right direction to get things rolling.
This year, we spent hours collecting our favorites to help you get ahead of your holiday shopping. This list has everything: minimalist smart rings , Play-Doh flowers , sleek beat machines — you name it. Whatever your needs, no matter how demanding the recipient, you’ll find something exceptional below for that special someone on your list.
Most of us have thousands of photos in the cloud, but if a photo never makes it into the real world, did it really happen? Existentialism aside, the Cricut StickerPix offers a new way to play with photos, providing you with everything you need to turn any picture into a pro-quality print or sticker.
If you’re a fan of Apple’s open-ear standard AirPods, the AirPods 5 are the best model yet. The higher-end pair (there are two models) offers upgraded sound, better noise cancellation, and swipe-based volume controls, bringing some Pro-level features to the buds that started the wire-free revolution.
It’s rare for a product to boast that it’s “hacker-friendly,” but the Busy Bar isn’t your average device. Equipped with a pixelated LED screen, fantastically fun buttons, and intriguing ways to play, Flipper’s open-source productivity tool breeds efficiency by, among other things, keeping coworkers from interrupting your flow with their weekend plans.
Espresso in the woods? Yes, please. The GR2’s magical mechanics make it possible, letting you turn 12 ounces of grounds into espresso without power. Its carrying case houses all the accessories needed to get that sweet shot of bean, making real coffee available virtually anywhere.
Digital photos changed everything, but there’s still something wonderful about the visceral touch and nostalgia of analog. Fujifilm’s Instax Mini Evo provides an intriguing hybrid that bridges these worlds, with a retro design, intuitive dials and controls, and the ability to filter like it’s 1989 (or 1889?).
What if you could give the gift of stress-free Wi-Fi on the go? That’s the promise of TP-Link’s dual-band Roam 7, a portable Wi-Fi 7 router that simplifies connecting to public portals so travelers can connect everything to a single device and be done with it.
For those who love travel but hate the constraints of a hotel TV, Belkin’s ConnectAir is a slick solution. Plug the transmitter into any device with a USB-C video-out port and the receiver into the TV’s HDMI port, and voilà, you’re easily (and wirelessly) connected.
The company that brought gaming to the masses still defies the odds, thanks in large part to its creative roots. Those roots run deep, and journalist Keza MacDonald’s fascinating book traces them to their source, from a simple card game company to the minds behind the biggest hits of all time.
You can give the gift of creativity with this do-it-all digital music maker. Akai’s portable sampler, beat maker, and all-around sound machine blends tactile quick keys and pads with an onboard screen so musicians can build it all in a box and send the results to their DAW of choice.
For those who enjoy clever devices that just work, we give you Nimble’s “breakable” SharePower Portable Charger. The magnetically joined power bank quickly snaps into a pair of 20W batteries, letting two people charge their phones, or works as a single 10,000mAh unit for larger top-offs.
New Zealand artist Aldous Harding has another eccentric album on her hands with this year’s Train on the Island . The slow-burning LP is gorgeously recorded and delightfully weird, and it feels tailor-made for vinyl, making it an easy pick for Harding fans (or anyone who loves quirky indie jams).
For those in smaller dwellings, efficient living means maximizing space. That’s where combo appliances like Ninja’s newest microwave / air fryer combo come in. The handy countertop gadget lets you zap your food, then crisp it at the end so your pizza or French fries don’t turn into a soggy mess.
Perhaps no game in history is more anticipated than the latest entry in Rockstar’s sprawling, intricate, and absolutely bonkers open-world series. Grand Theft Auto VI is said to offer a more obsessively dense map, more realism in details like weather and passing time, and more realistic NPCs (non-player characters) than ever before. Here’s hoping those 13 years were worth the wait.
Open-style earbuds aren’t just for the sporty; they’re an entirely different way to listen that keeps you environmentally aware without the plugged-up feeling of traditional buds. The OpenFit Pro take a balanced approach, with seamless open-ear performance and even a touch of noise reduction to dampen the din on crowded commutes.
The old Ironman Timex was a staple for ’80s and ’90s kids, and while you can’t bring back those carefree days, remakes like the Retroware can bring back that carefree feeling. No smarts, no notifications, just a takes-a-licking Timex watch with tactile keys, 50 meters of water resistance, and totally tubular digital graphics.
Serious gamers need a serious controller, and few take gaming more seriously than 8BitDo’s Elite-style Xbox gamepad. From its drift-proof TMR joysticks and motion support to its customizable buttons and remappable bumpers, the Ultimate 3E is the gift for that lovable control freak in your life.
There’s regular Play-Doh for kids, but did you know that Play-Doh makes kits for adults, too? We’re not scoffing. The new Blooms sets take on Lego’s floral bouquets with more realistic-looking flower arrangements, and they include a vase. They’re equal parts nostalgic kitsch and stylish decor.
For on-the-go creators, it’s all about capturing the moment in the highest video quality possible. Insta360’s Luna Pro steadycam offers plenty of features to get the job done right, including 4K vertical video, swift file transfers, four hours of battery life, and a detachable touchscreen that doubles as a remote.
The new Fitbit Air provides the same great fitness tracking we’ve come to expect in a comfortable design that virtually disappears on your wrist. Google’s AI Coach can be overly assertive, but the tracker’s great battery life and metrics for everything from sleep to blood oxygen make it an excellent gift for anyone who needs a healthy hand.
Most mobile controllers have a serious size limit. Not Razer’s Kishi V3 Pro XL, which lets you throw a big ol’ tablet between the handles for a major visual upgrade. It also has high-quality joysticks, great grips, and customizable keys for USB-C tablets, along with haptics for Android models.
So what if you’ve heard “Golden” more times than you can count? Netflix’s massive animated hit is a lot easier to gift now that it’s officially available on 4K Blu-ray disc. The story about three pop stars who band together to save humanity from a demonic boy band is an instant classic, with fantastic music and striking animation.
If you’re contemplating a pricey pair of sleep buds for your loved one, we urge you to halt and consider a softer (and cheaper) alternative. Piercing pillows, designed with pockets for freshly pierced ears, also work great for regular earbuds. Blissbury’s comfy and adjustable Ear Pillow is our favorite. Iran flogged pop singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her concert team on Monday following a December 2024 performance near Qom in which she sang without a hijab, her lawyer said.
Lawyer Mostafa Nili told Emtedad news channel that the Qom prosecutor's office enforcement team carried out the sentence against Ahmadi in the early hours of Monday.
The flogging sentences against band members Sohail Faghih-Nasiri, Amin Taheri and Amirali Pirnia, and concert organiser Mohsen Lashkari, were carried out on the same day, Nili said.
A criminal court in Qom province had sentenced nine members of the concert team to 74 lashes each, a two-year ban on leaving the country and a two-year ban on artistic activity.
The judiciary also sealed off the Deyr Gachin Caravanserai, the historic venue where the concert took place.
Ahmadi performed at the caravanserai near the historic city of Qom on the evening of 11 December 2024 without hijab. No audience was present.
The concert was broadcast live on YouTube and drew around 3 million views in the days that followed.
Ahmadi described the performance as a "hypothetical concert." Writing on her YouTube channel, she said, "I want to sing for the people I love. This is a right that I could not give up, that is, singing for the land that I love passionately."
The criminal court of Qom charged the group with "offending public decency by producing and disseminating vulgar and immoral content online."
Amnesty International called in June for the sentences to be quashed, saying flogging was "a cruel, inhuman and degrading punishment" that violated the absolute prohibition on torture and other ill-treatment.
The organisation called on Tehran to abolish compulsory veiling and corporal punishment and to end the criminalisation of freedom of expression.
Under Islamic Republic law, women are banned from singing in public in spaces where men are present.
Although criminal law does not explicitly criminalise women's singing as such, female performers typically face charges of encouraging corruption and prostitution, failing to observe hijab, or offending public decency.
Authorities have used the charge in recent years to close many Instagram pages belonging to Iranian female singers. Appearing in public without hijab is punishable by between 10 days and two months in prison, up to 74 lashes or a fine.
The sentences against Ahmadi and her collaborators stand in contrast to scenes from pro-government rallies held during the US and Israeli military strikes on Iran earlier in 2026, when images circulated widely showing women at the gatherings without mandatory hijab.
A performance by Lebanese singer Julia Boutros was also broadcast at a pro-government gathering in Tehran, where Boutros also did not wear hijab.
Earlier, during the Woman, Life, Freedom protest movement in 2022, Ahmadi had performed the protest song "Az khun-e javanan-e vatan" or "From the blood of the nation's youths".
After it was widely shared on social media, her home was searched by security forces and she was ordered to report to the security prosecutor's office in Tehran.
The Woman, Life, Freedom movement emerged in Iran in September 2022 following the death of Mahsa Amini, 21, in the custody of Tehran's morality police. Amini had been detained over alleged issues with her hijab.
Human rights organisations say the subsequent crackdown left more than 500 people dead.

Proposed sanctions aim to curb Russian crypto financing and ‘propaganda’ in sports.
The European Commission has proposed new sanctions against Russia targeting its banks, crypto platforms, and participation in sporting events.
Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen introduced the 22nd package of sanctions on Monday, which includes a ban on Russian teams and individual athletes competing under the country’s flag at events in the European Union.
“We are striking harder at Russia’s ways to finance its war, by targeting its banks and crypto platforms,” von der Leyen wrote in a post on X, adding that the EU will be “shutting the door to its participation in European sports and cultural events”.
Von der Leyen said 60 banks will be removed from the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) messaging system used for international payments under the new proposals, which are intended to maintain economic pressure on Russia, almost five years into its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
She announced the creation of a crypto sanctions task force seeking to curb countries helping Russia to evade sanctions.
The commission also proposed a ban on visas for Russians who had fought in the war in Ukraine.
“Russian ex-combatants pose a security risk to Europe. They cannot be allowed to wander freely across our countries,” von der Leyen said.
The plan also put forward restrictions on financial flows from Russian sponsors to sports and cultural associations based in the EU. Russian nationals would also no longer be allowed to hold leadership positions on the governing bodies of sports federations.
“Sports events cannot be a forum for propaganda activities,” said von der Leyen.
The proposed package must be endorsed by all 27 EU member countries before going into force and comes just over a month after the bloc posted the largest listing of sanctions against Russia, targeting about 1,600 Russian officials and companies linked to its arms industry.
The EU has already slapped sanctions on more than 4,200 people and entities, including Russian President Vladimir Putin and several energy companies.

The video was posted on YouTube in December 2024. In addition to the flogging, the five were banned for two years from taking part in artistic and musical activities and leaving Iran.
Western governments and human rights groups have condemned flogging as a form of torture that violates international law.
Iran rejects criticism of its human rights record and says Western countries should address abuses of their own.

French woman says she will pursue legal action against publisher and author over use of photos taken by convicted husband
Gisèle Pelicot has said she is “deeply shocked” that nude photographs of her had been used without her consent to promote a psychoanalyst’s book that suggests she was complicit in her abuse.
Pelicot, 73, became a global icon in the fight against sexual violence in 2024 during the trial that saw her former husband convicted of drugging and raping her , as well as recruiting 49 other men to rape her while unconscious.
“I am deeply shocked that images from the most intimate part of my private life are being displayed and exploited for commercial purposes,” Pelicot told broadcaster BFM TV. “I refuse to let my privacy become an advertising tool.”
She said she would pursue legal action against Tinbad publishing house and the author, Sabine Prokhoris, who has described her book as “a critical examination of the notion of psychological control and domination”. One chapter concerns the Pelicot case.
Tinbad sent some media nude photographs and graphic videos of Pelicot, which her husband had taken, to promote the book, according to French weekly le Canard enchaîné.
“Today I find myself once again humiliated, exposed and hurt,” Pelicot told the broadcaster. “As if the ordeal of the trial had not been enough.”
Tinbad has apologised, describing the episode as an “unfortunate communication error”.
The publisher maintained that it had not sent “any images of rape or any pornographic videos” to the press, while not denying that nude photographs had been distributed.
Prokhoris said she placed “full responsibility” for the “inappropriate” promotional campaign on her publisher.
According to her book’s back-cover blurb, it calls for readers to “think freely” about the notion of coercive control, described as “a cornerstone of #MeToo orthodoxy”.
Tinbad said that no further print runs of the book would be produced beyond the 280 copies already in circulation.

The 73-year-old told French broadcaster BFM TV she would take legal action against the publisher and author of the essay.
Pelicot made headlines across the world when she waived her right to anonymity in the trial of her then-husband Dominique, who was jailed for 20 years for drugging and raping her, as well as allowing other men to rape her while she was unconscious.
The publisher apologised, saying it would no longer print or promote the work after "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

"Today I find myself once again humiliated, exposed and hurt, as if the ordeal of the trial had not been enough," she said.
The essay was written by Sabine Prokhoris, a philosopher and psychoanalyst, who has previously criticised the Me Too movement.
French media reported that Tinbad, a small Paris publishing house, emailed nude photos of Pelicot taken by her ex-husband to some media outlets in order to promote the essay.
In a statement on its website, Tinbad said that no further print runs of the book would be produced beyond the 280 copies already in circulation.
"We offer our sincerest apologies to Ms Gisèle Pelicot," it said. The company also apologised to the author.
Tinbad said "no images of rape or pornographic videos" were sent to the media.
French news agency AFP quoted the blurb of the book as saying coercive control was "a cornerstone of #MeToo orthodoxy".
"These psychological situations, fundamentally ambiguous in nature, involve each of the parties in an equally responsible, though not symmetrical, way," it said.
Pelicot's lawyer Christophe Bigot told BFM the book "calls into question her status as a victim".
Prokhoris told AFP that she placed "full responsibility" for the "inappropriate" promotional campaign on her publisher.
Fifty men were convicted alongside Pelicot's ex-husband in 2024, in a case that made her a global feminist icon.
After her husband was arrested for secretly filming underneath women's skirts in a supermarket, she discovered she had been repeatedly raped by dozens of men, including her husband, while unconscious, over a period of nearly a decade.
Pelicot said she decided to waive her right to anonymity to show how "shame has to change sides" from victims to perpetrators.

Anchored in a Mediterranean harbour nearly 2,000 miles from Moscow, the Captain of Russia's corvette Merkury might well have thought his ship was safe from attack. It wasn't.
The audacious and successful night-time attack in Benghazi , co-ordinated by Ukraine's SBU intelligence agency and its armed forces, has raised the obvious question: is the Ukraine war spreading well beyond its borders?
The answer is yes, in fact, it was already spreading. But this attack, which Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky called "an exemplary operation" will inevitably raise the stakes another notch.
Russia, which is currently engaged in a non-stop campaign to batter Ukraine's civilian population into submission with daily missile and drone strikes , has called it "a dangerous escalation".
It follows the suspected Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian dry-cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland at the weekend, which the Kremlin described as an act of terrorism.
Ukraine's long-range drones have also previously struck Russia's Baltic oil terminal at Ust-Luga.
Some of Ukraine's more audacious long-range drone attacks – what Zelensky likes to call "long-range sanctions" – have also struck targets thousands of kilometres beyond Ukraine's borders with Russia, deep inside Siberia.
The most notable of these was last year's Operation Spider's Web, which involved a specially adapted lorry that drove close to a Russian strategic nuclear bomber airbase and released a "swarm" of explosive drones that damaged or destroyed several expensive bombers.
And Ukraine has also been active further south in Africa where its forces have targeted Russian mercenaries from the Africa Corps, the successor to the infamous Wagner Group that was accused of carrying out numerous human rights abuses.
It's not just Russia that will be alarmed by this latest Ukrainian operation in Benghazi harbour. The United Nations mission in Libya has already expressed its "deep concern".
Libyan officials point out that their country is not a party to the Russia-Ukraine war, although the Merkury and an accompanying cargo ship that was also hit were berthed in the eastern part of Libya controlled by the pro-Moscow warlord and self-styled "Field Marshal" Khalifa Haftar.
Throughout this year the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) has condemned all attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and today the global shipping community will be wondering whether this attack does indeed set a dangerous precedent.
If Ukraine can plan and execute such a bold attack on Russian ships in a nominally neutral harbour so far from home, where does this stop?
As the fifth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine approaches, this war has already been spreading, notably in other parts of Europe.
On Friday, several Russian projectiles landed well inside Poland's borders , just 60 miles from an Anglo-French exercise of forces intended to be deployed following an eventual ceasefire in Ukraine.
This, said Poland's PM Donald Tusk, was "a deliberate provocation" by Moscow.
It's not the first time Russian munitions have landed inside Poland, and therefore inside Nato territory, but observers have pointed out that Russia's probing of Nato's borders is becoming ever more brazen and some are calling for a firmer response.
But Russia is already heavily sanctioned by the West, with Europe having reduced much – but not all – of its energy imports from Russia, so the options for retaliation are limited, short of military confrontation, which no one wants.
Watch: CCTV shows explosion after Poland says airspace violated by Russian missile
Both Romania and Moldova have found themselves frequently struck by overflying Russian drones targeting Ukraine's Black Sea ports, while Bulgaria and Romania have suffered maritime drone attacks on commercial shipping just offshore in the Black Sea.
In the case of Romania, a Nato member, fast jets have had to be scrambled to intercept incoming Russian drones and there is a profound suspicion that these incursions are not all accidental.
The three Baltic states – Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania – all have borders with Russia and all consider themselves right on the front lines in this war.
There have been a number of anonymous attacks on military industrial facilities in these countries, blamed on agents acting on Moscow's behalf.
Russia, for its part, suspects Estonia of being complicit in Ukrainian drone attacks on the Baltic involving overflights through Estonian airspace.
It refers to the practice, by either side, of carrying out largely anonymous and unattributable operations using methods like cyber attacks, the burning down of warehouses supplying military equipment and the dispatching of drones, both for surveillance and loaded with explosives.
This autumn, Germany's Leipzig-Halle airport, which is used as a resupply hub by Ukraine's cargo aircraft, was targeted by three explosive drones that were discovered before anyone was hurt.
There have been other incidents involving explosive packages sent across Europe targeting Germany, Poland and the UK. Moscow denies any involvement.

After a period of doubts about the EU’s ability to introduce meaningful new sanctions on Russia , the European Commission is again attempting to increase the pressure.
The European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen , has revived a proposal to ban Russian soldiers from entering EU territory, as part of a package of restrictions on Russian banking ( 16:04 ), energy ( 16:05 ) and sports ( 16:06 , 16:07 , 16:09 ) announced today, the 22nd round of sanctions against the Kremlin’s war machine.
A few months ago it was not certain there would be any substance to a 22nd package.
During painful negotiations over the 21st package in July, one existing sanction (on the transfer of liquified natural gas) was diluted and EU member states delayed a plan to ban ex-combatants from entering the bloc, amid opposition from France and Italy, two countries that have handed out large numbers of tourist visas. Then September saw two oligarchs removed from the EU sanctions list.
Von der Leyen concluded in the same month that the EU should focus on closing loopholes. “What is needed is not necessarily new sanctions, but above all the enforcement of existing sanctions,” she said in her state of the union speech.
But since then, Russia has intensified its bombardment of Ukraine exacting a terrible price in lives. And there have been more hostile acts in the EU blamed on Russia, such as the attempted assassination of a US-Ukranian rapper in Denmark attributed to Russian intelligence services, the thwarted Leipzig airport drone attack, and a spate of deadly drone strikes in the Black Sea.
The latest announcement shows that sanctions hawks are in the ascendancy, such as Estonia , which has championed the cause of banning Russian ex-combatants from EU territory, as well as prohibiting Russians from competing in sports events under their national flag.
This does not mean the latest package is guaranteed to pass intact – sanctions still have to be agreed by 27 member states unanimously – but the argument that the EU does not need new measures is less and less convincing for top policymakers in Brussels. The calculus has changed.
Meanwhile, Finland has summoned the Russian ambassador to condemn recent attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine and incidents in Europe.
“Finland has summoned the Russian Ambassador. We strongly condemn Russia’s illegal war of aggression and its escalating strikes against civilian targets in Ukraine. We stand in solidarity with Denmark, Poland and our other European partners.
Russia’s dangerous and reckless actions in Europe are unacceptable. A Russian helicopter is also suspected of violating Finnish airspace on Saturday 21 November.
Ukraine has the right to defend itself against Russia’s illegal aggression. Russia must end its war of aggression against Ukraine.”
The EU’s accompanying release says that the ban on Russian sportspeople means that “ Member States notably should consider refusing Schengen visas to Russian athletes competing in sporting events where Russian national symbols such as the flag, anthem, or uniforms are used.”
“The guidelines call as well for specific attention to be given to individual artists participating in cultural events , who are sponsored by the Russian authorities and who can use their visibility in favour of Russia’s war of aggression.”
The EU will also introduce “bans on Russian teams and athletes competing under the Russian flag,” von der Leyen says.
We will also restrict financial flows from Russian sponsors to European based sports and cultural associations, and we will introduce restrictions on Russians holding posts in governing bodies of European based sports federations.
“Our position is clear. We’re giving Ukraine the strength to secure a peace. And Russia, every reason to choose it.”
Von der Leyen also says the EU will “prohibit Europeans from continuing to occupy posts in the governing bodies of companies in Russia .”
“There cannot be business as usual in our economic relations with Russia.”
Von der Leyen says the EU will also “propose a visa ban for Russian ex-combatants.”
“We have recently seen an escalation in non-conventional kinetic activities of Russian operatives in Europe. And this ban is a part of our response.
Russian ex-combatants pose a security risk to Europe. They cannot be allowed to wander freely across our countries. Therefore, entry into the European Union will be off limits.”
On energy, the EU is “expanding the energy services ban so that no European company can help Russia build, operate or repair its energy infrastructures and notably its refineries,” von der Leyen said.
“For the first time, this ban also covers electricity services on the Russian shadow fleet. We are listing over 70 more ships and we are proposing to ban all tanker vessels, which are, in short, in Russia.”
On financial services, the new measures “extend the transaction ban to some 60 Russian banks,” which will be removed from the Swift system.
“And we’re cracking down on the crypto and payment networks. We will focus on Russia, but also include third countries that help Russia to evade our sanctions.
This is a major focus of our new package and an important area where we want to align efforts with international partners, and this is the reason why we have also launched a crypto sanctions taskforce to support this work.”
“The aim is to keep pressure on Russia to end their war of aggression in Ukraine, and we will continue to propose new sanctions until Russia shows genuine intent for lasting peace in Ukraine.
With this package, we are increasing the pressure in three ways:
We’re striking harder at Russia’s way to finance its war by targeting its banks and crypto platforms.
We’re shutting the door to its participation to European sports and cultural events. We’re tightening our visa rules, sports and cultural events. We’re tightening our visa rules, and we’re doubling down on enforcement.”
Meanwhile in Brussels, the European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen is just announcing the EU’s 22nd package of sanctions against Russia .
Meanwhile, Merz has gone as far as to say that it was a “mistake” that the Nato summit in Bucharest in 2008 did not accept the proposal to accept Ukraine as a Nato member.
“If Ukraine had become a member of Nato [then], this war would have possibly probably been prevented,” he said.

Mexican officials say the United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help locate and capture one of the country's most wanted drug traffickers. The operation led to the arrest of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as 'El Chapo Isidro'.
The United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help the government track down and capture a top drug lord over the weekend in Sinaloa, Mexican security officials said Monday.
The recent detention of Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro” illustrates increasing law enforcement cooperation between the neighboring countries, but U.S. involvement in Mexican security operations has long been a touchy subject.
U.S. President Donald Trump has pressured Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum to crack down on cartels, while Mexico has repeatedly underscored its sovereignty . On Monday, Sheinbaum emphasized that U.S. forces were not allowed to operate on the ground in Mexico and the governments were only sharing intelligence.
“This case in particular demonstrates the capacity of the armed forces” of Mexico to make major detentions, Sheinbaum said.
The U.S. has sought to line up allies across Latin America to allow them to operate in their territories, with mixed responses from across the region.
The weekend detention of the capo, who was one of the FBI 's most wanted fugitives, triggered a burst of violence in the northern state of Sinaloa that left 20 people dead in the city of Guasave. Among them were four soldiers and 16 suspected criminals, Mexican officials said Monday.
Defense Secretary Gen. Ricardo Trevilla Trejo said Monday that the capture of Meza Flores and 16 members of his criminal group was the result of “very important intelligence sharing” with U.S. authorities over the past three months to pinpoint Meza Flores’ location in Guasave.
In the week leading up to Meza Flores’ capture, that included authorizing the U.S. to fly intelligence drones over Mexican territory, to assist Mexican law enforcement to later surround the capo and go in for the capture, Trevilla Trejo and other Mexican officials said. They emphasized that the intelligence mission was carried out in compliance with Mexican law.
Authorities also noted on Monday that the U.S. had an existing extradition request for Meza Flores for drug trafficking charges, leaving open the possibility that the cartel boss may be sent north to face justice.
His capture was celebrated by Mexican and U.S. law enforcement as a major blow to criminal groups in the region.
The U.S. government highlighted its intelligence support in the operation, but did not immediately provide more details about the use of the surveillance drone when asked on Monday.
Meza Flores led the Beltran Leyva organization and later became the leader of his own group, the Meza Flores Transnational Criminal Organization. He was also a key ally of a Sinaloa Cartel faction known as “Los Mayos," which is locked in a brutal territorial war against another cartel faction in the Mexican state.
The capture of Meza Flores was the latest in a string of targeted operations against cartel kingpins by Mexican authorities, the largest of which was the February killing of Jalisco New Generation Cartel leader Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes , known as " El Mencho ."
While the captures show that the government is doubling down on its fight on crime, many experts were quick to emphasize that the strategy could backfire.
In previous anti-crime offensives in Mexico and other parts of Latin America, knocking out cartel leaders without debilitating the entire criminal structure around them has largely only fueled bloody power struggles between cartel factions. That has been the case in recent years in Sinaloa.

Watch: Carney and Trump impersonators take stage with real Mark Carney
Prime Minister Mark Carney brought a Donald Trump impersonator on stage at Ottawa's annual press gallery dinner, where he poked fun at strained US-Canada relations and on-again, off-again trade talks.
The impersonator, played by comedian Mark Critch of the sketch comedy show This Hour Has 22 Minutes, came out after Carney jokingly pressed an "emergency comedy button" during his speech.
Critch appeared alongside another actor impersonating Carney, played by Canadian sketch comedian Mark McKinney.
"We've got two Carneys here, it's a disaster," the Trump impersonator said after he walked on stage.
Using some of Trump's signature mannerisms, like his dance moves and his slightly hunched posture, he joked about the latest US midterm elections, which led to Trump's Republican Party losing control in Congress.
"I'm so popular we just had a big BLUE WAVE in the states," the impersonator said at the Saturday press gala.
He also took aim at ongoing US-Canada trade negotiations, saying,"We're going to have a great deal. There's only one thing standing in the way: me, because I'm crazy."
There were also jabs at Trump's search for a new White House press secretary following Katie Zacharia's exit, and at US ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra, who is unpopular among Canadians.
"I said 'find somebody who is less likeable than me,' and we got one," the Trump impersonator joked about Hoekstra.
Carney stood behind him occasionally laughing. The prime minister also delivered his own zingers, saying at one point: "This is a tough room. And I've been in the Oval Office. Alone. With its new interior decorator."
Both Critch and McKinney - the two impersonators - are fixtures of This Hour Has 22 Minutes, a long-standing Canadian sketch comedy show that has recently enjoyed viral internet fame for its timely skits mocking the Trump administration.
The skits, published directly on Tik Tok and YouTube, have depicted Zacharia's quick ouster , external and poked fun at rapper Nicki Minaj's , external support for Trump.
They have garnered millions of views, and even captured the attention of major US media. , external
Critch and McKinney's appearance at Saturday's dinner is part of an evening of traditionally light-hearted humour, where Canadian politicians poke fun at one another at a gala hosted by the Canadian Parliamentary Press Gallery.
In a separate speech, Canada's governor general, Louise Arbour, joked about Carney's popularity and frequent global travel.
"Our prime minister is already getting a lot of attention. Actually, I heard a guy the other day compare him to God. Now seriously, do you know the difference between God and Mark Carney? God is everywhere, and Mark Carney is everywhere except in Ottawa where he's supposed to be," Arbour said.

Carney watches on as comedian lampoons US leader and his interest in men’s backsides at correspondents’ event Ottawa
Canada’s prime minister, Mark Carney, was joined on stage in Ottawa by a Donald Trump impersonator who mocked the US president to raucous laughter from a crowd of politicians and journalists at a parliamentary press gallery dinner on Saturday.
With coiffed hair and an ill-fitting suit, comedian Mark Critch – who portrays the president on the sketch show This Hour Has 22 Minutes – danced on to the stage and lampooned the trade war Trump started as well as the president’s threats to annex Canada .
“We’re going to have a great deal,” Critch said, channeling Trump’s distinct mannerisms. “There’s only one thing standing in the way: me, because I’m crazy.”
The fake Trump continued that he was “so popular we just had a big, blue wave”, a reference to the Democratic rout of Republicans in this month’s US midterm elections.
He also mocked Trump’s frequent mentions of other men’s physiques, saying of the comedian Mark McKinney, who was portraying Carney, that he had “a great ass – doesn’t he? What a beautiful ass, he’s got such an incredible ass.”
He earned the most laughter of his short appearance for saying of Carney: “I don’t call him the governor to his face, because I’m a coward”. The real Trump has frequently attempted to insult Canada’s leaders by calling them governor, not prime minister, suggesting Canada is a US state.
The annual dinner, attended by media, political leaders and lobbyists, is often defined by carefully written jokes by the staff of party leaders.
Throughout his own 16-minute set, Carney poked fun at his political rivals, the media and the US president.
At one point, he remarked: “Damn, this is a tough room, and I’ve been in the Oval Office. Alone. With its new interior decorator.”
Clips of the dinner, including the crowd laughing at the president, have circulated widely on US media.
The newly appointed governor general, Louise Arbour, also gave a speech, including a nod to the prime minister’s decision to travel extensively around the globe.
“Our prime minister is already getting a lot of attention. Actually, I heard a guy the other day compare him to God. Now seriously, do you know the difference between God and Mark Carney ? God is everywhere, and Mark Carney is everywhere except in Ottawa where he’s supposed to be,” she said.
The Conservative leader, Pierre Poilievre, also used the evening to poke fun at his own reputation.
“Some say that Mark has a controlling leadership style. There’s been reports that he yells and micromanages his staff. He acts like a miserable prick to journalists,” he said. “And when I hear things like that, I say once again, he’s stealing all my ideas.”
He attracted a stunned silence, however, for alluding to Justin Trudeau’s relationship with Katy Perry, saying, “Trudeau is running around the world doing to a faded pop princess what he did to Canada” while prime minister, a remark that was widely criticised as demeaning to the pop star.
The New Democratic party leader, Avi Lewis, who has not yet won a seat in parliament, took a shot at Carney’s early exit from the event, as well his own party’s dismal standings. “I do not have a seat in the House of Commons, but when I am given one at dinner, I stay there all night long,” he said.

The US president used his podium to attack the California governor for a decision to commute 548 death sentences.
United States President Donald Trump has reaffirmed his support for the death penalty in an event that doubled as a platform to attack one of his most visible critics, California Governor Gavin Newsom.
On Monday, Trump spoke at the Department of Justice in Washington, DC, where he was joined by the families of crime victims and his attorney general, Todd Blanche.
“The ultimate crimes deserve the ultimate punishment,” Trump said of the death penalty, calling it a cornerstone of “ virtually every society throughout history, at least every successful society”.
“Under the Trump administration, we are bringing it back, and we will not stop in our pursuit of justice. We will not yield.”
He concluded the appearance by signing a presidential directive ordering the Department of Justice to seek the death penalty in murder cases involving children, rape and human trafficking.
The directive also pushes for the attorney general to “expedite” executions for those on federal death row.
As part of his speech, Trump called on Congress to pass the Just Punishment for Murder Act, a bill sponsored by Republican Representative Brandon Gill, which the president said would “strengthen the death penalty in America”.
But he dedicated much of his remarks to slamming Newsom, a Democrat widely seen as a possible contender for the 2028 presidential race.
Newsom’s second term as governor will end on January 4. Under California term limits, he was ineligible to run again in the 2026 midterm elections.
Still, the governor and former San Francisco mayor has carved a national profile for himself as a proxy for Democrats during high-stakes political campaigns — and as a critic of Trump.
Trump, however, zeroed in on one of Newsom’s final major actions while in office: commuting the sentences of those on California’s death row.
On November 5, two days after the midterms, Newsom announced that the 548 people sentenced to death in California would instead be sentenced to life without the possibility of parole.
He described the action as an extension of the moratorium on executions he put in place after taking office in 2019.
“I could not remain true to my values and oversee the killing of people with death warrants in California,” he wrote in an open letter.
He nevertheless denounced the harm the 548 people had caused.
“Many Californians feel that those who commit brutal crimes deserve to die,” Newsom wrote. “But as Governor, I have concluded the state cannot morally kill them.”
He called on Californians to let the 548 people “die in obscurity” while remembering their victims.
Trump, however, framed the mass commutation as an effort to help “evil monsters” escape justice.
“This afternoon, we come together to stand against the travesty and to wrap our arms around the families of victims who were so cruelly betrayed by bad government and our political system,” Trump said.
The president proceeded to launch barbs at Newsom, calling him “ a terrible governor” who “ stole away the only closure” the victims’ families “might ever have”.
He then invited several family members on stage to denounce Newsom’s decision.
“ You took the only justice we had and left families feeling abandoned by the state that promised to protect us,” Sandra Friend, the mother of eight-year-old murder victim Michael Lyons, said in her remarks, directed at Newsom.
In anticipation of Monday’s news conference, Newsom also released statements from families that supported his choice.
“When victims are this divided, the death penalty shouldn’t be the answer. Victims deserve so much more than a promise of justice through vengeance,” Jess Nichol, the sister of murder victim Polly Klaas, said in one of the statements.
“They deserve counselling, medical care, financial support, and a justice system that helps them heal. I want something better for survivors: real, tangible support.”
The tit-for-tat between Newsom and Trump comes as support for the death penalty has slumped in recent years.
A November poll released by the research firm Gallup found that 49 percent of US adults support the death penalty, the lowest rate since 1971.
Opponents of the death penalty have frequently pointed to the prevalence of botched executions and the possibility that innocent people may be executed.
The Death Penalty Information Center, a nonprofit, has found that approximately 202 people formerly on death row were later found to be wrongfully convicted. The exoneration rate, it said, was one for every eight people executed in the US.
Death penalty cases also typically tend to result in longer court battles and higher costs.
Before Newsom’s mass commutation, California reportedly had the largest death row in the Western Hemisphere, representing roughly a quarter of the country’s death sentences.
Newsom’s successor, Governor-elect Xavier Becerra, has pledged to continue the death penalty moratorium once sworn in.
But that policy puts California at odds with a push under Trump to embrace the death penalty and expand execution methods.
Upon taking office for a second term on January 20, 2025, Trump signed the first of several executive orders aimed at “restoring the death penalty”.
He pushed to have execution be the de facto punishment for the murder of law enforcement officers, as well as for murder cases where undocumented immigrants are the defendants.
In April, the Trump administration also said it would prioritise the use of the death penalty by expanding the acceptable methods for federal execution, including firing squads .
In October, Trump’s Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that one execution by firing squad — that of the Fort Hood shooter, Nidal Hasan — would be livestreamed to the public, prompting backlash.
Trump later walked back the announcement, amid reports that he did not realise Hassan was in a wheelchair.
During his first term, Trump oversaw 13 federal executions, the most of any president in decades. In Monday’s speech, he framed such punishments as “common sense”.
“ When it comes to defending the lives and safety of American people, there can be no compromise,” he said.

Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has become increasingly vocal about AI as end of term nears.
United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has called for measures to better manage the risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) during a conference in Barbados.
“Today I call for member states to coordinate efforts and to develop within the next year a globally inclusive and principles-based multilateral framework for AI risk management, backed by independent and credible oversight,” Guterres said Monday.
Guterres, who is approaching the end of his term due in December, has become increasingly vocal about the need for safety measures around advanced technology to avoid a future in which “ killer robots ” are a reality.
Guterres said Monday at the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety that “when one looks at different other institutions of global governance … they correspond to the reality of the world in 1945”.
“It’s clear that institutions need to be reformed in order to adapt themselves to the realities of today’s world,” he said.
“That applies to the UN, and that applies to the international financial architecture, that applies to the world trade system.”
Guterres said that he would advise his successor, due to take office in the new year but yet to be selected, that properly controlling AI would be necessary for “humanity to maintain control of our world”.
International regulation of AI appears distant as the technology’s superpowers, the United States and China, continue to seek the upper hand in research and development breakthroughs.
Nonetheless, Guterres said that a starting point could be for countries to agree on shared safety measures, a testing regime and basic requirements for independent oversight.
In September, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX chief Elon Musk called for a slowdown in the development of AI.
Others, like Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, want to move full steam ahead.
Regulators in the US, where AI development has proceeded at the fastest pace, appear unlikely to immediately intervene.
In September, US President Donald Trump hosted a group of American tech executives who agreed to abide by a voluntary code of conduct on AI safety.

Galatasaray , UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi 'nin 5. haftasında 24 Kasım Salı günü saat 20.45'te RAMS Park'ta Aston Villa'yı konuk edecek. Karşılaşma TRT 1'den canlı yayınlanacak. Milli maç arasından beri süren çim yenileme çalışmalarının ardından zeminin toparlandığı görülüyor. Ancak bazı bölümlerde kumların belirgin şekilde seçilmesi, maçın sorunsuz oynanıp oynanamayacağı sorusunu gündeme getirdi.
Milli maç arasından beri aralıksız süren çalışmalar sonucunda RAMS Park zemininin toparlandığı görülüyor. Buna rağmen bazı bölümlerde kumların zemin üzerinde belirgin şekilde seçilmesi dikkat çekti. Kumların zemine tam anlamıyla oturmaması, maçın oynanıp oynanamayacağı konusunda soru işaretleri yarattı. Sarı-kırmızılılar, stadyum zeminindeki sorun nedeniyle Süper Lig'in 12. haftasında Samsunspor'u Başakşehir Fatih Terim Stadyumu'nda ağırlamıştı.
UEFA, ev sahibi kulübün saha zeminini mümkün olan en iyi oyun koşullarında tutmasını zorunlu kılıyor. Kulüp, zeminin futbol oynamaya elverişli olması için gerekli tüm makul önlemleri almak zorunda. UEFA müsabaka öncesinde saha zeminini denetleyebiliyor ve hava koşulları gerektiriyorsa saha ısıtma ya da koruma sistemlerinin kullanılması isteniyor. UEFA Stadyum Talimatı'nın 5.01 maddesinde şu ifade yer alıyor:
'Oyun alanı düzgün ve düz olmalı, IFAB Oyun Kuralları'na uygun olmalıdır.'
Bu yüzden ciddi çukurlar, tehlikeli bozulmalar ya da futbolcuların güvenliğini tehdit eden sorunlar, UEFA'nın saha standartlarına aykırılık sayılabiliyor.
UEFA kurallarına göre bozuk zeminde de Şampiyonlar Ligi maçı oynanabiliyor. Çimlerin seyrek ya da sararmış olması tek başına otomatik erteleme nedeni sayılmıyor. Hakem sahada derin çukur , buzlanma ya da don, aşırı çamurlaşma ve drenaj yetersizliğinden kaynaklanan su birikintisi olup olmadığına bakıyor. Top normal şekilde sekmiyor ya da yuvarlanmıyorsa veya zemin futbolcular için ciddi sakatlık riski taşıyorsa maç ertelenebiliyor ya da tatil edilebiliyor. Aşırı yağış yüzünden saha oynanamaz hale gelirse de aynı yol izleniyor.
Zemin maç gününe kadar standartlara getirilemezse UEFA ev sahibi kulübe uyarı veriyor. Para cezası kesmesi ya da maçın standartlara uygun başka bir stadyuma, yani tarafsız sahaya alınmasına hükmetmesi de mümkün. UEFA'nın 26. maddesi, zemin müsabakaya uygun değilse maçın saatinin, tarihinin ya da stadyumunun değiştirilmesine izin veriyor. Maç öncesinde bu kararı UEFA yönetimi veriyor. Maç başladıktan sonra zemin elverişsiz hale gelirse hakem, UEFA delegesiyle ve mümkünse UEFA yönetimiyle görüşüp karşılaşmayı durdurabiliyor. Oynanamayacağına karar verilen maç kural olarak ertesi gün oynanıyor, bu mümkün olmazsa yeni tarihi UEFA belirliyor.

İstanbul Sarıyer'de ortaya çıkan dişi aslan paniği gündemdeki yerini koruyor. Uskumruköy Mahallesi'nde 22 Kasım akşamı güvenlik kameralarına yansıyan hayvanın bulunması için ekiplerin başlattığı çalışmalar sürüyor.
İstanbul Valiliği tarafından yapılan açıklamada, saat 18.00 sıralarında aslan olduğu değerlendirilen bir hayvanın güvenlik kameraları tarafından görüntülendiği bildirildi. Bunun üzerine Doğa Koruma ve Milli Parklar ekipleri, jandarma ve Sarıyer Belediyesi zabıta ekipleri harekete geçti. Gece boyunca termal kameralı dronlarla ormanlık alanlarda arama yapıldı. Hayvanın konumu bir süre tespit edilse de daha sonra izine ulaşılamadı.
Arama çalışmaları Uskumruköy çevresiyle sınırlı kalmadı. Bahçeköy, Zekeriyaköy ve Demirciköy'ü de kapsayacak şekilde genişletilen çalışmalar kapsamında Belgrad Ormanı araç ve yaya girişine kapatıldı.
Aslanın nereden geldiği ve kime ait olduğu henüz belirlenemezken, olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı. Türkiye'de bireysel olarak aslan beslenmesinin yasak olması da hayvanın olası bir özel mülkten kaçmış olabileceği ihtimalini gündeme taşıdı.
Arama çalışmalarının sürdüğü bölgede yaşayan ünlü isimlerden Yasemin Tatlıses de yaşadığı endişeyi sosyal medya hesabından paylaştı.
İdo Tatlıses'in eşi olan ve Zekeriyaköy'de yaşayan Tatlıses, otomobiliyle ormanlık bir yolda ilerlerken çektiği görüntüyü Instagram hikâyesinde yayımladı. Arama bölgesinin yakınında bulunması nedeniyle dikkat çeken paylaşımına, "Önüme aslan çıkacak diye korkuyorum ya, şaka gibi" notunu ekledi.
Tatlıses, paylaşımında yalnızca yaşadığı korkuyu dile getirmekle kalmadı, aslanın sahibine yönelik de tepki gösterdi.
Ünlü isim, "Yani nereden kaçtı, nasıl kaçtı bilmiyorum ama biri evinde besleyecek zihniyetteyse umarım o da tespit edilip bulunur" ifadelerini kullandı.
Sarıyer'deki aslan arayışı, bölgede yaşayan başka tanınmış isimlerin paylaşımlarıyla da gündeme gelmişti. Survivor yarışmasıyla tanınan Avatar Atakan, arama çalışmaları sırasında aslanla aralarında yaklaşık 150-200 metre mesafe bulunduğunu söyleyerek dikkat çekmişti.
Bölgede yaşayanların tedirginliği sürerken, ekiplerin kayıp dişi aslanı bulmak için yürüttüğü çalışmalar devam ediyor.

Paul Potts was managing Port Talbot's Carphone Warehouse store at the time of his audition
Britain's Got Talent winner Paul Potts said he nearly missed his life-changing audition on the show because he had been unable to get time off from his job managing a phone shop.
The tenor shot to fame in 2007 after performing Nessun Dorma on the ITV talent show, but had unsuccessfully tried to change the date of his performance because of his shift at Port Talbot's Carphone Warehouse.
"It was only thanks to a colleague who normally didn't work Saturdays that came into cover me – otherwise I wouldn't have been there," he said.
He has since released six albums, reached the final of America's Got Talent: The Champions and inspired the Hollywood film One Chance.
"I actually almost didn't end up going," he told BBC Radio Wales' My Welsh Life.
Almost 20 years later, as he prepares for a special homecoming concert in Port Talbot, Potts said he was honoured to be "still doing what I love doing".
"The only reason why I'm still doing that is because people still support me and I'll always be forever grateful for that."
Potts's homecoming, marking 20 years since his victory on Britain's Got Talent, will be in the newly refurbished Princess Royal Theatre, now renamed Y Storfa.
The Port Talbot tenor talks Britain's Got Talent, and plans to perform again on home soil
Having seen photographs of the renovation, he said it looked like a "massive improvement", adding that investment in cultural venues was part of a wider regeneration of Port Talbot.
He described the people in Port Talbot as a big part of what made the town special, and its community spirit appealed to him.
"People have always been really self-deprecating and that suits my sense of being very well as well."

Yeşilçam 'ın tanınan isimlerinden Sibel Turnagöl, MasterChef'in 21 Kasım bölümüne konuk oldu. Son dönemde Maslak Oto Sanayi'ndeki esnaf lokantasıyla anılan 58 yaşındaki oyuncunun görünümü sosyal medyada övgü topladı. Turnagöl, ekranlara dönüp dönmeyeceği sorusuna da 'Ben de özledim' diye yanıt verdi.
Uzun süredir ekranlardan uzak duran Sibel Turnagöl, TV8'de yayınlanan MasterChef Türkiye 'nin 21 Kasım akşamki bölümünde konuk olarak yer aldı.
Oyuncunun yıllar sonra kameraların karşısına geçmesi, özellikle onu Yeşilçam filmlerinden hatırlayan izleyicilerin gözünden kaçmadı. Turnagöl'ün programda yer alması kısa sürede sosyal medyanın gündemine oturdu.
Turnagöl'ün son dönemdeki gündemi ise ekrandan oldukça uzaktı. Oyuncu, Maslak Oto Sanayi'nde işlettiği esnaf lokantasıyla konuşuluyordu. 2023 yılında açılan lokantanın menüsünde İzmir köfte, orman kebabı ve et sote gibi ev yemekleri yer alıyor. Menüdeki fiyatlar da kısa süre önce dikkat çekmişti.
MasterChef bölümünün ardından sosyal medyada Turnagöl'ün görüntüleri paylaşıldı. Yorumlarda öne çıkan ortak nokta, oyuncunun doğal görünümü oldu. 'Doğal yaşlanmış', 'Estetiksiz gibi ne güzel' ve 'Vay be kadın aynı kalmış' gibi yorumlar öne çıktı. Kullanıcılar, Turnagöl'ün yıllar sonra bile tanınır kalmasını ve estetik müdahale izlenimi vermeyen görünümünü takdirle karşıladı.
Ekranlara dönüşüyle ilgili sorular üzerine konuşan Turnagöl, bu konuda bir çalışma yürüttüğünü söyledi: 'Mustafa Bey ile çalışıyoruz. Böyle çok gönlümüze göre bir şey olduğu zaman inşallah olacak. Ben de özledim.'
Oyuncu, projenin ayrıntısına ya da ne zaman ekranlara geleceğine dair bir bilgi vermedi. Ancak bu sözler, Turnagöl'ü yeniden bir dizide ya da filmde görmek isteyen hayranları için umut verici oldu.
Sibel Turnagöl, 16 yaşında katıldığı bir yarışmada 'Mankenler Kraliçesi' seçilerek adını duyurdu. Ardından Yeşilçam 'da rol almaya başladı.
Kadir İnanır 'la 'Sen Türkülerini Söyle' filminde oynayan Turnagöl, ' Bebek ', 'Skandal' ve 'Günah Tohumu' filmlerinde de yer aldı. 'Yasemin', 'Bana Sevgiyi Anlat' ve 'Asla Unutma' dizilerinde rol alan oyuncu, televizyonda sunuculuk da yaptı.
Turnagöl, bir dönem Kerem Alışık ile evliydi. 2012 yılında Mehmet Çelik ile evlenen oyuncu, bu evliliğin ardından ekranlardan uzaklaştı.

Turkcell Basketbol Gelişim Merkezi'nde düzenlenen medya günü etkinliğinde Türkiye Basketbol Federasyonu Başkanı Hidayet Türkoğlu, A Milli Basketbol Takımı Başantrenörü Ergin Ataman, ay-yıldızlı ekibin genel menajeri Nedim Yücel ile kaptan Kenan Sipahi, açıklamalarda bulundu.
Hidayet Türkoğlu, yaptığı açıklamada, milli takımın elde ettiği başarılardan gurur duyduklarını dile getirerek "Taraftarlarımıza teşekkür ediyorum. Onların desteğiyle ekibimiz bir ilki başardı. Avrupa ikinciliğinden sonra 8'de 8 yaparak Dünya Kupası'na gitmeyi hak eden ilk ülke olduk. Her ne kadar bazı şeyleri garantilesek de sporcularımız her zaman milli formanın gururunun ve sorumluluğunun bilincinde. İnanıyorum ki sahaya da bu düşünceyle çıkacaklar ve milyonları gururlandıracak performans sergileyecekler." ifadelerini kullandı.
İtalya ve İzlanda karşılaşmalarının önemine değinen Başkan Türkoğlu, "Amacımız yükselen basketbolumuzla dünya sıralamasında ilerlemeye devam etmek. Bu açıdan İtalya ve İzlanda maçı bizim için çok değerli. Kadromuzda bulunan genç oyuncular için de önemli bir fırsat olacak. Kendi takımlarında bulamadıkları süreleri milli takımda elde ederek önemli tecrübeler kazanacaklar." diye konuştu.
Ay-yıldızlı ekibin geçen yıl elde ettiği Avrupa ikinciliğinin ardından başarılı performansını sürdürdüğünü vurgulayan Türkoğlu, şu görüşleri paylaştı:
“2025'te uzun yıllardan sonra çok anlamlı bir başarı elde ettik. Bu eleme pencerelerinin ne kadar önemli olduğunu da görme fırsatı buluyoruz. Bir yıl içerisinde 8 maç yaptık ve hepsinden galibiyetle ayrıldık. Bu, sporcularımızın neleri başarabileceklerini ve hangi seviyede olduklarını görmelerini sağladı. Elde ettikleri başarı daha önce ulaşamadığımız bir başarı. Oyuncularımız bunun bilincinde ve hiçbir şekilde rehavete kapılmadılar. Avrupa ikinciliği onları çok iyi motive etti. Gerek bizleri gerekse milyonları gururlandıracak performanslar sergilemeye devam ettiler. Kaptanımız Cedi Osman sakatlandı. Kendisine 'Geçmiş olsun' dileklerimizi iletiyoruz. Bazı oyuncularımız NBA'de. Hocamız da yeni genç oyuncuları denemek istiyor. Bu nedenle geniş bir kadroyla kampa başlıyoruz. Milli takım, genç oyuncularımız için bulunabilecekleri en büyük arena. Bu fırsatı iyi değerlendireceklerine inanıyorum. Aynı istikrar ve özgüvenle 2027 Dünya Kupası'na hazırlanmak istiyoruz.”
Hidayet Türkoğlu, devşirme oyuncu statüsünde bulunan milli basketbolcu Tarık Biberovic'in durumuna ilişkin FIBA ile yaptıkları görüşmelerden sonuç alamadıklarını belirtti.
FIBA yetkilileriyle bir araya geldiklerini aktaran Başkan Türkoğlu, "Geçen gün FIBA'ya bir ziyaretimiz oldu ve bu konuda görüşmeler yaptık. Maalesef süreçlerin FIBA tarafından aynı şekilde yürütüleceği bize bildirildi. Tarık şu anda oynadığı statüde (Devşirme) oynamaya devam edecek. FIBA'nın kendi düzenlemeleri nedeniyle haklı olduğu noktalar var. Bizim de anlatmak istediğimiz konular oldu ancak sonuçta FIBA'nın bu yönde aldığı bir karar var. Tarık mevcut statüsünde oynamaya devam edecek." değerlendirmesinde bulundu.
A Milli Erkek Basketbol Takımı Başantrenörü Ergin Ataman, eksiklerinin bulunduğunu ancak her şeye rağmen iki maçta da en iyi mücadeleyi sahaya koyacaklarını söyledi.
Avrupa'da Dünya Kupası'na katılmayı garantileyen tek takım olduklarını hatırlatan Ataman, şu ifadeleri kullandı:
"İtalya ve İzlanda ile çok zorlu iki maç oynayacağız. Bu takımların hepsi grupta ilk üç sıra için büyük mücadele veriyor. Bizim durumumuz biraz farklı. Her maça kazanmak için çıkacağız. Özellikle İtalya maçında bugüne kadar yer vermediğimiz, daha az dakika alan oyuncularımızı oynatmayı planlıyoruz. Takım kaptanımız Cedi Osman'ın sakatlığı bulunuyor. Ömer Faruk Yurtseven ise NBA Gelişim Ligi'nde. EuroLeague'deki 3 takımımızın yarın ve çarşamba günü çok önemli maçları var. Bu oyuncuları hiç antrenman yapmadan İtalya maçına getireceğiz. Şu aşamada çok kaliteli bir basketbol oynamamızı beklemiyorum. Özellikle İtalya maçında tamamen yeni bir kadroyla oynayacağız. İtalya maçı zor olacak ama sonuç ne olursa olsun burada İzlanda ile oynayacağımız karşılaşma da çok önemli. İzlanda yıllardır aynı kadroyla oynayan ve zorluk çıkaran bir takım. İki maçı da kazanmak istiyoruz. İtalya'daki sonuç ne olursa olsun İzlanda maçını mutlaka kazanmak için sahaya çıkacağız."
Bu pencere maçlarında alışılmış oyun tarzlarının dışında bir basketbol sergileyebileceklerini aktaran Ergin Ataman, "Biraz sıkıntılı bir süreç olacak. Bu pencere maçlarında A Milli Takımımızın alışageldiğimiz oyun tarzından farklı bir oyun görebiliriz ama hiç kimse endişe etmesin. Milli forma için hangi oyuncular sahada olursa olsun kazanmak için en iyi şekilde savaşacaklar." şeklinde konuştu.
Ergin Ataman, özellikle 4 ve 5 numara pozisyonlarında önemli eksiklerinin bulunduğuna vurgu yaparak şunları kaydetti:
"Doğuş Özdemiroğlu, Avrupa Kupası'nda önemli istatistikler ortaya koyuyor. Cedi Osman'ın yokluğunda onu kadroya dahil ettik. Furkan Korkmaz'ın Fenerbahçe maçındaki performansı da ümit vericiydi. Cedi'nin olmadığı yerde Furkan'ı kullanacağız. Ancak uzun pozisyonunda ciddi eksiklerimiz var. Yazın oynadığımız pencere maçlarında Alperen Şengün yoktu. Ömer Faruk Yurtseven ile Adem Bona'yı kullanmıştık. Şimdi ikisi de yok. Beş numara pozisyonunda Sertaç Şanlı, Furkan Haltalı ve genç oyuncumuz Rüzgar'ı kadroya kattık. Ercan Osmani'yi İtalya maçında kullanmayacağız çünkü Anadolu Efes'in bir gün önce deplasman maçı var. Onun yetişmesi pek mümkün görünmüyor. İzlanda maçında kullanacağız. Yiğitcan Saybir'in çok ciddi sakatlığı var. Onu da kadrodan çıkarmak zorunda kaldık. Karşıyaka'dan Yavuz'u almıştık ancak o da son lig maçında sakatlandı. Milli takım tecrübesi daha az olan oyuncularla oynayacağız ancak onların da en iyi şekilde katkı vereceğini düşünüyorum."
Dünya Kupası kadrosunu oluşturma sürecinde farklı oyuncuları da görmek istediklerini vurgulayan deneyimli başantrenör, "Dünya Kupası'na katılmayı garantiledik. Bu nedenle yelpazeyi biraz daha geniş tutup şu ana kadar şans vermediğimiz oyuncuları da kullanmak istiyoruz. Dünya Kupası kadromuza hangi oyuncuları dahil edebileceğimizi görmek istiyoruz." dedi.
Devşirme oyuncu tercihiyle ilgili de konuşan Ergin Ataman, Malachi Flynn ile devam edeceklerini belirtti.
Her maçta farklı bir devşirme oyuncu kullanmak istemediklerini anlatan Ataman, şunları söyledi:
“Zaten birçok yeni oyuncumuz var. Malachi Flynn son dönemde A Milli Takımımız ile beraber. Hem oynadığı basketboldan hem de takıma uyumundan çok memnunuz. Şu dönemde EuroLeague'de oynamaması da bizim için avantaj. Burada iki gün antrenman yapacağız ve bu antrenmanlara katılabilecek tek devşirme oyuncu Flynn. Bu nedenle bu pencere maçlarında Malachi Flynn ile oynayacağız. Şubat ayında da herhangi bir sakatlık olmazsa büyük ihtimalle onunla devam ederiz. Larkin'in performansı yükselmeye başladı. Scottie Wilbekin uzun bir sakatlıktan sonra son maçlarda iyi performans gösteriyor. Tarık Biberovic de bu statüde. Dünya Kupası'na giderken en formda ve en çok kullanabileceğimiz oyuncuyu o zaman belirleyeceğiz.”
A Milli Erkek Basketbol Takımı Genel Menajeri Nedim Yücel, bu eleme maçlarının genç oyuncuların performanslarını görmek açısından önemli bir fırsat olduğunu kaydetti.
Başarılı performanslarını sürdürmek istediklerini belirten Yücel, "Dünya Kupası'na katılmayı garantileyen ilk ülke olmanın ve namağlup devam etmenin gururunu yaşıyoruz. Bu başarıyı sürdürmek istiyoruz. Kadroyu biraz geniş tuttuk. Diğer potansiyel oyuncuların da milli takıma katkılarını görmek istiyoruz. Avrupa kupalarında oynayan takımların ve ligin çok yoğun bir temposu var. Oyuncularımıza ve kulüplerimize gösterdikleri özveri için teşekkür ediyoruz. Genç oyuncularımızı görmek açısından çok önemli bir fırsat olacak. Ömer yazın zaten bizimle beraberdi. Onları görmüş olacağız. Ömer, Real Madrid'de artık A takım kadrosuna alındı. İnşallah önümüzdeki dönemde milli takımımıza çok önemli katkılar verecektir." diye konuştu.

23 ve 24 Kasım gecesi gözlemlenebilecek dolunay, hem geleneksel adı hem de Dünya'ya yakın konumuyla öne çıkıyor.
Kasım dolunayı, Kuzey Amerika'da kunduzların yaklaşan soğuk kış aylarına hazırlanmak için yoğun faaliyet gösterdiği döneme denk geldiğinden "Kunduz Ayı" (Beaver Moon) diye adlandırılıyor.
Süper Ay, dolunayın Ay'ın Dünya çevresindeki eliptik yörüngesinde gezegenimize en yakın olduğu dönemlere denk gelmesiyle ortaya çıkıyor.
Ay'ın Dünya'ya uzaklığı yıl boyunca değiştiğinden bazı dolunaylar diğerlerine göre biraz daha büyük ve parlak görünüyor.
Ancak uzmanlara göre bu fark, çoğu zaman çıplak gözle kolayca ayırt edilemiyor.
Öte yandan Ay, ufuk çizgisine yakın olduğunda olduğundan daha büyük ve turuncu görünebiliyor. Bu durumun büyüklükle ilgili kısmı, "Ay yanılsaması" olarak bilinen optik bir algıdan kaynaklanıyor.
Kasım ayındaki dolunay, Şubat 2027'ye kadar art arda gerçekleşecek dört süper ayın ilki olacak.
Kunduz Süper Ayı, Türkiye'nin de bulunduğu Kuzey Yarımküre'de gün batımı civarında doğu ufkundan yükselecek.
Gece boyunca güney gökyüzünde ilerleyecek olan Ay, ertesi sabah gün doğumu civarında batı ufkundan kaybolacak.
Gökyüzü olayını izlemek isteyenlerin gün batımından hemen sonra doğu ufkunun açıkça görülebildiği, yüksek binalardan ve yoğun ışık kirliliğinden uzak bir noktaya gitmesi öneriliyor.
Ay'ın ufuktan yükseldiği ilk saatlerde daha büyük ve turuncu görünmesi de mümkün.
Güney Yarımküre'de ise dolunay yine doğudan yükselecek ancak gece boyunca gökyüzünün kuzey kesiminde ilerleyecek.
Bu yılki Kunduz Süper Ayı'nın bir başka özelliği, gökyüzünde iki önemli yıldız kümesinin yakınında görülecek olması.
Dolunay, Ülker ve Hyades yıldız kümelerine gökyüzünde yakın bir konumda bulunacak.
Her iki yıldız kümesi de Boğa Takımyıldızı bölgesinde yer alıyor.
Ancak dolunayın güçlü parlaklığı, bu yıldız kümelerinin çıplak gözle görülmesini zorlaştırabilir.

Kasım ayının Süper Ay'ı, 24 Kasım Salı günü Boğa takımyıldızındaki Pleiades yıldız kümesinin yalnızca 0,9 derece yakınından geçecek. Halk arasında Yedi Kız Kardeş olarak bilinen küme ile Ay'ın bu buluşması, haftanın en dikkat çekici gök olayı sayılıyor. Aynı hafta Mars, Venüs ve Uranüs de gökyüzünde öne çıkacak.
Haftanın ilk gözlem fırsatı 23 Kasım Pazartesi akşamı ortaya çıkıyor. Hava karardıktan sonra doğu yönüne bakıldığında, neredeyse dolunay evresindeki Ay, Boğa takımyıldızındaki Pleiades kümesinin yakınında görülebilecek. Ay'ın parlaklığı kümedeki sönük yıldızların seçilmesini zorlaştırsa da en parlak üyeler Ay'ın çevresinde fark edilebilecek.
Asıl buluşma ise 24 Kasım Salı günü gerçekleşecek. Kasım dolunayı, Ay'ın Dünya'ya en yakın olduğu yörünge noktası olan yerberi konumuna yakın oluşuyor ve bu nedenle Süper Ay olarak anılıyor. Dolunay, Pleiades kümesinin 0,9 derece kuzeyinden geçerken gökyüzünde haftanın en dikkat çekici manzaralarından birini oluşturacak.
25 Kasım Çarşamba sabahı, Güneş doğmadan yaklaşık bir saat önce doğu yönüne bakıldığında Mars ile Regulus yan yana görülecek. Aslan takımyıldızının en parlak yıldızı olan mavimsi Regulus ile kızıl renkli Mars, gökyüzünde dikkat çekici bir renk kontrastı oluşturacak. Jüpiter de parlaklığıyla bu iki gök cisminin yakınında öne çıkacak. Aynı gün Uranüs karşı konumuna ulaşacak, ancak bu gezegeni gözlemlemek için büyük dürbün ya da teleskop gerekecek.
27 Kasım Cuma günü ise Venüs sabah gökyüzünde en parlak görünümüne ulaşacak. Güneş doğmadan yaklaşık 45 dakika önce doğu-güneydoğu yönüne bakıldığında gezegen kolayca fark edilebilecek. Dünya'ya görece yakın konumu ve ışığı güçlü biçimde yansıtan yoğun bulutlu atmosferi sayesinde Venüs, sabah saatlerinin en dikkat çekici cisimlerinden biri olacak.
Süper Ay ifadesi, dolunayın her zamankinden çok daha büyük görüneceği beklentisini doğurabiliyor. Oysa aradaki fark sanıldığından küçük. Dolunay yerberi civarında gerçekleştiğinde Ay, ortalama bir dolunaya kıyasla yaklaşık yüzde 7-10 daha büyük ve yüzde 15 daha parlak görünebiliyor. Bu fark çıplak gözle her zaman kolayca anlaşılmıyor, ancak özellikle Ay doğarken daha etkileyici bir görüntü ortaya çıkıyor.
Ay'ın ufka yakın konumdayken olduğundan büyük algılanmasının nedeni ise 'Ay yanılsaması' olarak bilinen optik etki. Bu durum Ay'ın gerçek boyutundan değil, insan beyninin ufuk çizgisindeki nesneleri algılama biçiminden kaynaklanıyor.
Kasım ayının sonlarına doğru kış gökyüzü de belirginleşmeye başlıyor. Akşam saatlerinde güneydoğuda yükselen Orion takımyıldızı kolayca fark ediliyor. Orion'un üzerinde Boğa, sol tarafında İkizler, altında ise Sirius yer alıyor. Orion, Boğa, Arabacı, İkizler ve Büyük Köpek takımyıldızlarının parlak yıldızlarıyla şekillenen bu geniş desen 'Kış Altıgeni' olarak biliniyor. Haftanın takımyıldızı ise Perseus. Cassiopeia ile Boğa arasında bulunan bu takımyıldız, akşam saatlerinde kuzeydoğuya bakılarak aranabiliyor. Cassiopeia'nın W harfine benzeyen şeklinden Boğa'ya uzanan hayali bir çizgi izlendiğinde Perseus'un yıldızlarına ulaşılabiliyor.
24 Kasım'daki Süper Ay'ın ardından Ay her gece biraz daha küçülecek ve gökyüzünde daha geç saatlerde doğacak. Böylece ayın sonuna doğru yıldız gözlemi için daha karanlık akşamlar geri dönecek. Aralık ayında ise 14-15 Aralık gecelerinde zirveye ulaşacak Geminid meteor yağmuru ve 21 Aralık'ta yaşanacak kış gündönümü, gözlemcilerin takvimine eklenecek.

1912'de batan Titanik'in yolcularına ait 100'den fazla eşya, İngiltere 'nin Wiltshire bölgesindeki Devizes kasabasında müzayedeye çıkarıldı. Satışı Henry Aldridge and Son müzayede evi düzenledi ve toplam gelir 1 milyon sterlini aştı. Gelirin büyük bölümünü Titanik bağlantılı parçalar sağladı.
Satışın en yüksek fiyatı, üçüncü sınıf yolcu Mary Mangan'a ait altın cep saati için ödendi ve saat 250 bin sterline alıcı buldu. Bu rakam, üçüncü sınıf bir yolcunun eşyası için şimdiye kadar verilen en yüksek bedel oldu. Mangan'ın cansız bedeninde bulunan saat, daha önce Titanic Belfast müzesinde de sergilenmişti.
Tanınmış yolcu Lady Duff Gordon'a ait elmas yüzük 140 bin sterline satıldı ve gemiyle bağlantılı bir mücevher için ödenen en yüksek tutar oldu. Birinci sınıf yolcu Ramon Artagaveytia Gomez'in Titanik antetli kâğıda İspanyolca yazdığı mektup ise 80 bin sterline gitti. Su lekeli mektup, müzayedenin öne çıkan kâğıt parçalarından biri oldu.
Nadir bir Titanik bileti 45.500 sterline, bir sigorta belgesi 27 bin sterline el değiştirdi. Telsiz operatörü Jack Phillips'in kız kardeşi Elsie'ye yazdığı kartpostal yaklaşık 32 bin sterlin getirdi ve geminin batmasından dört gün önce kaleme alınmıştı. Müzayede yöneticisi Andrew Aldridge, satışlara dünyanın farklı yerlerinden koleksiyonerlerin katıldığını ve fiyatların Titanik'e olan ilginin sürdüğünü gösterdiğini belirtti.

Sude Erdoğan 'ın 23 yıl önce başlayan yaşam mücadelesi, yıllar sonra unutulmayacak bir mezuniyet hikayesine dönüştü. Bir zamanlar hayatını kurtaran doktor, bu kez ona diplomasını verdi.
Sude Erdoğan 'ın Prof. Dr. Mehmet Haberal ile yolları 2003 yılında kesişti. Henüz 22 aylık bir bebekken karaciğer nakline ihtiyaç duyan Sude'ye annesi Sonnur Erdoğan donör oldu. Annesinden alınan karaciğer, Prof. Dr. Mehmet Haberal tarafından gerçekleştirilen operasyonla küçük Sude'ye nakledildi. Başarılı nakil sayesinde hayata tutunan Sude Erdoğan, çocukluk ve gençlik yıllarını geride bırakarak eğitim hayatını tamamladı. Aradan geçen 23 yılın ardından bu kez ameliyat masasında değil, mezuniyet töreninde Haberal'ın karşısına çıktı.
Başkent Üniversitesinin 2025-2026 akademik yılı mezuniyet töreninde Siyaset Bilimi ve Uluslararası İlişkiler Bölümünü tamamlayan Sude Erdoğan, diplomasını Prof. Dr. Mehmet Haberal'ın elinden aldı. Yıllar önce yaşamını kurtaran doktorla bu kez mezuniyet sevincini paylaşan Erdoğan için tören, sıradan bir üniversite mezuniyetinden çok daha fazlasını ifade ediyordu. 23 yıl önce kendisine yeni bir hayat veren Haberal, bu kez eğitim hayatının tamamlanmasının ardından diplomasını uzattı.
Sude Erdoğan, Prof. Dr. Mehmet Haberal ile arasındaki bağın yıllar içinde doktor ve hasta ilişkisinin çok ötesine geçtiğini söyledi. Haberal'dan "manevi dedem" diye bahseden genç kadın, diplomasını onun elinden almanın kendisi için taşıdığı anlamı şu sözlerle anlattı: “Bana ikinci bir yaşamın kapılarını açan aynı insanın elinden diplomamı almak, hayatımın en anlamlı ve gurur verici anlarından biri oldu. Bana verilen ikinci hayatın değerini üreterek, çalışarak ve insanlara dokunarak göstermek istiyorum.”

It was a record-breaking occasion in more ways than one. David Moyes made history for Everton, edging clear of Harry Catterick by overseeing his 593rd game in charge of the club, but calamitous defending ruined the Scot’s evening and defeat to Brentford was inevitable after James Tarkowski received his first red card in 351 Premier League appearances.
Those in Tarkowski’s corner will claim the Everton captain’s tackle on Yehor Yarmoliuk would not have been a foul back in the day. This, though, was not a “game’s gone” moment. Not that sort of player? The reality is Tarkowski’s back catalogue features plenty of orange card tackles, meaning there was always likely to come a time when his luck ran out.
Everton, whose passive performance denied them the chance to go fifth, should not bother complaining about Matthew Donohue’s intervention from Stockley Park after Tarkowski went in on Yarmoliuk with his studs raised late in the first half. It was the defender’s first red since he was playing for Brentford in the Championship and it had no great bearing on the result. Brentford led 2-0 before their former player went off, Keane Lewis-Potter’s third and fourth goals of the season putting them in control, and dominated from start to finish.
Keith Andrews, a young coach who will have done something right if he comes close to matching Moyes’s longevity, revelled in his side moving sixth thanks to an outstanding display. Moyes has been around long enough to know the top flight has rarely been this open but on this evidence Brentford look likelier than Everton to upset the established order.
It was a drubbing, a cracking third from Vitaly Janelt followed by Fábio Carvalho making it 4-0 in added time, and made clear that Brentford have the tools to challenge for European qualification.
With Igor Thiago unavailable after his controversial red card against Brighton it fell to Callum Wilson to lead the line for Brentford. Everton were unsettled by Wilson’s movement and were strangely muted. They sat in a low block but were not compact, were careless in possession and did not deal with Brentford’s wing play and midfield interchanges.
Jaidon Anthony, Mikkel Damsgaard and Michael Kayode had chances before Everton cracked. They were caught out by a long ball down the left and were undone when a poor clearing header led to a moment of brilliance from Anthony, the winger’s cushioned touch with the outside of his right foot running for Lewis-Potter to beat Jordan Pickford thanks to a deflection off Jarrad Branthwaite.
Brentford love to make the most of Lewis-Potter’s attacking instincts after converting him into a left-back. He joined as a winger and his runs are always a threat but Everton did not pay close enough attention. They were abysmal in the first half and faced more pressure when Vitaliy Mykolenko conceded a free-kick after losing Dango Ouattara. Damsgaard crossed, Everton were all at sea and Lewis-Potter scored via another deflection, this time off Thierno Barry.
Everton were dour. They sought a lifeline through Harrison Armstrong, Caoimhín Kelleher tipping the midfielder’s shot over, but composure eluded them. Tarkowski, seemingly rattled by the barracking from the home crowd, was off after storming into a challenge on Yarmoliuk. The initial call was a yellow but Tarkowski’s boot was high, the follow-through looked cynical and the force was excessive, convincing Craig Pawson to show a red after a VAR review.
“I don’t think you can tackle like that in this day and age,” Andrews said. Moyes was honest, admitting that Tarkowski’s boot was high. “I can see why the decision went against us,” Everton’s manager said.
Everton adjusted after going down to 10, Merlin Röhl going to right-back, and Barry’s header drew a superb save from Kelleher just before half-time. Brentford had to switch on. They were intense at the start of the second half and Ouattara nodded wide from Damsgaard’s cross.
Moyes had introduced Jack Grealish for Tyrique George. Yet Brentford recognised the threat and killed Everton off when Janelt used his left foot to belt a formidable shot past Pickford from 30 yards.
“We didn’t play well,” Moyes said. “It was really not like us. I’ve got no complaints with the players. They’ve done a brilliant job until now. Tonight’s performance was not excusable.”
Everton were outplayed on every metric. They were lucky Brentford waited so long to score a fourth, Carvalho coming on to round off the humiliation by bundling in a corner from close range.

Keane Lewis-Potter’s first-half double set Brentford on their way to a comprehensive 4-0 Premier League win over 10-man Everton.
For David Moyes it was a record-setting night to forget. His 593rd game in charge of Everton, more than any other Toffees manager, ended in misery, as James Tarkowski's red card at 2-0 down left them with no hope of a comeback at the Gtech Community Stadium on Monday night.
Vitaly Janelt added a third for Brentford, while Fabio Carvalho came off the bench to score a fourth, as they moved up to sixth in the table, a point above Everton who slipped to ninth.
It was a deserved breakthrough for Brentford midway through the first half. A lovely touch from Jaidon Anthony teed up Lewis-Potter, who saw his strike deflect past Jordan Pickford.
Four minutes later it was 2-0. This time it came from a free-kick as the ball fell to Lewis-Potter. His first effort was blocked, but he got a second bite at it, and again a deflection from his strike took the ball away from the Everton goalkeeper.
It got worse for the Toffees before the break, too. Tarkowski was first given a yellow card for his follow-through challenge on Yehor Yarmolyuk, before a VAR check saw the referee upgrade it to red.
Moyes introduced Jack Grealish at the start of the second half, his first appearance since being dropped from the squad last month, but it would make minimal difference.
Janelt's rocket on 67 minutes added a Brentford third, as he picked out the top corner from 25 yards, while substitute Carvalho prodded in from a corner in stoppage time to add the icing to the cake.
